SECTION 1: SPEC BULLET ANALYSIS

✅ * Select electrons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [l for l in leptons if l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: leptons -> selected_leptons; 〔L279-L281〕
✅ * Select muons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.4; computed as: [l for l in leptons if l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: leptons -> selected_leptons; 〔L279-L281〕
✅ * Require exactly one lepton (electron or muon); computed as: len(selected_leptons) == 1; upstream chain: selected_leptons; 〔L281〕
✅ * Require at least 4 jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: len(selected_jets) >= 4; upstream chain: jets -> selected_jets; 〔L288-L290〕
✅ * Among these selected jets, require at least 2 b-tagged jets.; computed as: len(selected_bjets) >= 2; upstream chain: bjets -> selected_bjets; 〔L295-L297〕
✅ * Among the selected b-tagged jets, define the b-jet closest to the selected lepton in delta R.; computed as: min_dr = float('inf'), closest_bjet = None, for b in selected_bjets: dr = helper_delta_r(lep, b), if dr < min_dr: min_dr = dr, closest_bjet = b; upstream chain: selected_bjets -> closest_bjet; 〔L304-L309〕
✅ * Select MET > 20 GeV; computed as: met['pt'] > 20; upstream chain: met; 〔L315〕
✅ * Select transverse mass of the lepton and MET between 30 and 150 GeV (W candidate); computed as: mt = helper_transverse_mass(lep, met), if mt < 30 or mt > 150: continue; upstream chain: lep, met -> mt; 〔L320-L322〕
✅ * Build the hadronic W candidate from the two leading selected non-b-tagged jets.; computed as: light_jets_sorted = sort_by_pt(selected_light_jets), leading_light_jet = light_jets_sorted[0], subleading_light_jet = light_jets_sorted[1], hadronic_w = sum_objects(leading_light_jet, subleading_light_jet); upstream chain: light_jets -> selected_light_jets -> light_jets_sorted -> hadronic_w; 〔L326-L336〕
✅ * Select the hadronic W mass between 40 to 120 GeV.; computed as: hadronic_w_mass = hadronic_w['mass'] if hadronic_w else 0.0, if hadronic_w_mass < 40 or hadronic_w_mass > 120: continue; upstream chain: hadronic_w -> hadronic_w_mass; 〔L337-L338〕
✅ * Build the hadronic top candidate from the leading selected b-tagged jet and the hadronic W candidate.; computed as: bjets_sorted = sort_by_pt(selected_bjets), leading_bjet = bjets_sorted[0], hadronic_top = sum_objects(leading_bjet, hadronic_w); upstream chain: selected_bjets -> bjets_sorted -> leading_bjet -> hadronic_top; 〔L342-L345〕
✅ * Select the hadronic top mass between 100 to 250 GeV.; computed as: hadronic_top_mass = hadronic_top['mass'] if hadronic_top else 0.0, if hadronic_top_mass < 100 or hadronic_top_mass > 250: continue; upstream chain: hadronic_top -> hadronic_top_mass; 〔L347-L348〕

SECTION 2: DEFINITION SUMMARY

* [CHECK CAREFULLY] DEFINITION SUMMARY

* selected_leptons
  - computed/defined as: [l for l in leptons if l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: leptons -> selected_leptons
  - collection definition: l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* selected_jets
  - computed/defined as: [j for j in jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: jets -> selected_jets
  - collection definition: j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* selected_bjets
  - computed/defined as: [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: bjets -> selected_bjets
  - collection definition: b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* closest_bjet
  - computed/defined as: for b in selected_bjets: dr = helper_delta_r(lep, b), if dr < min_dr: min_dr = dr, closest_bjet = b
  - upstream chain: selected_bjets -> closest_bjet
  - collection definition: helper_delta_r(lep, b)
  - structure: single-constituent

* met
  - computed/defined as: helper_get_met(event)
  - upstream chain: event -> met
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: single-constituent

* mt
  - computed/defined as: helper_transverse_mass(lep, met)
  - upstream chain: lep, met -> mt
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: multi-input

* selected_light_jets
  - computed/defined as: [j for j in light_jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: light_jets -> selected_light_jets
  - collection definition: j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* light_jets_sorted
  - computed/defined as: sort_by_pt(selected_light_jets)
  - upstream chain: selected_light_jets -> light_jets_sorted
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: single-constituent

* hadronic_w
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(leading_light_jet, subleading_light_jet)
  - upstream chain: leading_light_jet, subleading_light_jet -> hadronic_w
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: composite-derived

* hadronic_w_mass
  - computed/defined as: hadronic_w['mass'] if hadronic_w else 0.0
  - upstream chain: hadronic_w -> hadronic_w_mass
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: single-constituent

* selected_bjets_sorted
  - computed/defined as: sort_by_pt(selected_bjets)
  - upstream chain: selected_bjets -> selected_bjets_sorted
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: single-constituent

* leading_bjet
  - computed/defined as: selected_bjets_sorted[0]
  - upstream chain: selected_bjets_sorted -> leading_bjet
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: single-constituent

* hadronic_top
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(leading_bjet, hadronic_w)
  - upstream chain: leading_bjet, hadronic_w -> hadronic_top
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: composite-derived

* hadronic_top_mass
  - computed/defined as: hadronic_top['mass'] if hadronic_top else 0.0
  - upstream chain: hadronic_top -> hadronic_top_mass
  - collection definition: None
  - structure: single-constituent
